errors.evidence: The x-axis tick marks are labeled every two years (1946, 1948, 1950, etc.), not every five years.
The lowest point on the solid line occurs in 2016, not 2014. The value in 2014 is approximately 3.1, whereas the minimum value in 2016 is approximately 2.85.
The value for the solid line in 2018 is approximately 2.95, which is closer to 3.0 than 2.9.
The value for the dotted trend line in 2018 is approximately 2.95, which is closer to 3.0 than 2.9.
